learner_starting_state: Can distinguish system, user, and grounding input and trace a lightweight Foundry client flow.
learner_ending_state: Can decide when one agent is appropriate, define its instructions and least-privilege tools, test it safely in the portal, and trace a lightweight client interaction.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on both primary and fresh-transfer forms across all six single-agent boundaries, then explain the workflow and external-action safeguard without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: Current agent concepts and portal workflow cite official Microsoft Foundry and AI-901 sources.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify portal labels, APIs, SDKs, tool availability, identity terms, models, pricing, previews, and deprecations before live use.

notes: Offline design and assessment only; no service call, Azure mutation, or external action is authorized.
